build_metadata_for_language: run build_metadata to generate per-language metadata JSON from WordNet, n-grams, and Wikipedia titles
run_batch_metadata_build: run the script without arguments to submit batch jobs for all wiki language codes via submitit
check_punctuation_character: use is_punctuation to check if a single character is ASCII or CJK punctuation
check_pure_punctuation_string: use is_pure_punctuations to check if a string contains only punctuation characters
review_wordnet_wiki_mapping: review the wordnet_to_wiki and wiki_to_wordnet dictionaries that map WordNet language codes to Wikipedia language codes
